scientific_question: Which source-native, deterministically derivable, or evidence-graded upgrade signals can close the observed Assistive Geometry capability gaps before payload download, teacher generation, or model training?
information_gain: Turn QSF, CBF, FCI and temporal negative support terminals into reusable source-admission tests, so incompatible sources are rejected before expensive acquisition or adaptation.
minimal_discriminating_experiment: Validate one metadata-only source manifest against the frozen gap contract and classify it PRESCREEN_ADMIT, PARTIAL, or REJECT without opening payloads; metadata never establishes source data support.

decision_semantics.PRESCREEN_ADMIT: Claim-bound metadata, governance checks and at least one gap screening contract match. Source data support remains false; only a separate source-specific integrity and payload-audit protocol may be locked next.
decision_semantics.PARTIAL: Governance passes and at least one relevant signal exists, but no complete direct-evidence gap contract passes. Missing or upgradeable signals remain explicit.
decision_semantics.REJECT: License, ancestry, independence, metadata-only access, UNKNOWN semantics, manifest integrity, or all relevant signal support fails. No payload or upgrade work is authorized.

resource_budget.current_lock: repository metadata and synthetic unit tests only

stop_conditions: Any bound protocol, gap, schema, DCA, validator, or test SHA drifts.
A source manifest lacks verified internal-research license, ancestry, or parent-independence basis.
Privacy, human-subject, access terms, role history, or the protected B1 identity firewall is unresolved.
Source-native provenance is treated as automatic ground truth or UNKNOWN is treated as negative.
A payload, teacher, pseudo-label generator, model, trainer, Development, or Confirmation outcome is opened under this protocol.
claim_ceiling: Gap contract, metadata-only source manifest schema, and static prescreen mechanics only. PRESCREEN_ADMIT does not establish source data support or DCA pass. No source has been admitted for payload use; no pseudo-label, teacher, materialization, model, training, Development, Confirmation, product, or safety authority.
